verdict.rationale: Cursor ships an official TypeScript SDK (@cursor/sdk) that lets your own code call the same agent used in the IDE, CLI and web app. It runs in local or cloud mode, accepts user and service-account keys, and comes with Cookbook end-to-end examples. A Python SDK and an SDK Bridge for other languages are also documented, and the API overview lists TypeScript and Python SDKs for all users. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use, and depth of Python SDK documentation beyond its listing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The `@cursor/sdk` package lets you call Cursor's agent from your own code.
The same agent that runs in the Cursor IDE, CLI, and web app is now scriptable from TypeScript
plus TypeScript and Python SDKs (all users)
